name: Garage
description: Garage is an S3-compatible distributed object storage service designed for self-hosting.
composeYaml:
services:
  garage:
    image: 'dxflrs/garage:v2.1.0'
    environment:
      - GARAGE_S3_API_URL=$GARAGE_S3_API_URL
      - GARAGE_WEB_URL=$GARAGE_WEB_URL
      - GARAGE_ADMIN_URL=$GARAGE_ADMIN_URL
      - 'GARAGE_RPC_SECRET=${RPCSECRET}'
      - GARAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN=${GARAGE_PASSWORD}
      - GARAGE_METRICS_TOKEN=${GARAGEMETRICS_PASSWORD}
      - GARAGE_ALLOW_WORLD_READABLE_SECRETS=true
      - 'RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-garage=info}'
    volumes:
      - 'garage-meta:/var/lib/garage/meta'
      - 'garage-data:/var/lib/garage/data'
      -
        type: bind
        source: ./garage.toml
        target: /etc/garage.toml
        content: "metadata_dir = \"/var/lib/garage/meta\"\ndata_dir = \"/var/lib/garage/data\"\ndb_engine = \"lmdb\"\n\nreplication_factor = 1\nconsistency_mode = \"consistent\"\n\ncompression_level = 1\nblock_size = \"1M\"\n\nrpc_bind_addr = \"[::]:3901\"\nrpc_secret_file = \"env:GARAGE_RPC_SECRET\"\nbootstrap_peers = []\n\n[s3_api]\ns3_region = \"garage\"\napi_bind_addr = \"[::]:3900\"\nroot_domain = \".s3.garage.localhost\"\n\n[s3_web]\nbind_addr = \"[::]:3902\"\nroot_domain = \".web.garage.localhost\"\n\n[admin]\napi_bind_addr = \"[::]:3903\"\nadmin_token_file = \"env:GARAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN\"\nmetrics_token_file = \"env:GARAGE_METRICS_TOKEN\""
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - /garage
        - stats
        - '-a'
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
